correctness.rationale: The proof derives the weighted single-pattern avoidance generating function from marked clusters, proves primitivity for q>=3 by a connector symbol distinct from the first and last letters, and establishes 1/q<rho<1/2 for m>=2. Differentiation yields (5) with a strictly negative prefactor. The longest nonzero border-prefix difference controls its sum by the rigorous geometric bound (6). Singleton forbidden words are treated separately. The separate transfer-matrix eigenvector checker agrees for all 703 small targets (3,129 letter pairs) and 135 direct finite enumeration sanity checks; universal validity comes from the proof, not enumeration.

value.rationale: A complete order of q stationary symbol frequencies is a natural structural invariant of a one-forbidden-word language; the theorem gives all pairwise signs and ties and a nontrivial uniformity criterion without computing a Perron eigenvector. The balanced-global-Parikh counterexample demonstrates it detects subtle overlap-dependent bias. This is a family-wide exact classification, rather than a finite coincidence.
